The first complete H03 link still needs the explicit application profile, sensor configuration, remaining platform providers, OEM startup composition and cumulative Flash/SPI/IRQ verification. Measure the final link after integration; the address model does not include all required providers.
A qualified DTC-04 physical backend and clear callback are required for durable 14 FF 00 success, with no RAM/history change or ACK on failure.

Toyota solenoid/pressure/lock-up monitors lack verified class/channel/threshold/recovery correspondence to Chery codes. Their raw qualification and feedback can be inspected without assigning a new code.

No verified H03 continuous ADC source for supply voltage or coil current was found. The provider returns raw AN1, commands, digital feedback and fault qualifiers; power/current are external measurements.
